Rule.title: SRG-APP-000855-DB-000240
Rule.Description: Fixture login rule. The logins it applies to are left to the organisation.
Rule.OrganizationValueTestString: SQL authentication logins are populated from organizational settings.

Rule.title: SRG-APP-000033-DB-000084
Rule.Description: Fixture script query rule carrying its own Get/Test/Set triad and no variable.
Rule.GetScript: USE [master] SELECT name, is_disabled FROM sys.sql_logins WHERE principal_id = 1 AND is_disabled <> 1;
Rule.SetScript: USE [master] DECLARE @SysAdminAccountName varchar(50), @cmd NVARCHAR(100), @saDisabled int SET @SysAdminAccountName = (SELECT name FROM sys.sql_logins WHERE principal_id = 1) SELECT @cmd = N'ALTER LOGIN ['+@SysAdminAccountName+'] DISABLE;' SET @saDisabled = (SELECT is_disabled FROM sys.sql_logins WHERE principal_id = 1) IF @saDisabled <> 1 exec sp_executeSQL @cmd;
Rule.TestScript: USE [master] SELECT name, is_disabled FROM sys.sql_logins WHERE principal_id = 1 AND is_disabled <> 1;

Rule.title: SRG-APP-000141-DB-000092
Rule.Description: Fixture script query rule whose SetScript uses a scripting variable nothing binds.
Rule.GetScript: SELECT name FROM sys.server_principals WHERE TYPE = 'S' and name not like '%##%'
Rule.TestScript: SELECT name FROM sys.server_principals WHERE TYPE = 'S' and name = 'sa'
